CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_collections (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,title VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX uc_user(user_id,updated_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_collection_items (collection_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,product_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(collection_id,product_id),INDEX uci_product(product_id))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS community_challenges (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,title VARCHAR(140) NOT NULL,title_ar VARCHAR(280) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',title_zh VARCHAR(280) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',description TEXT NOT NULL,status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,due_at VARCHAR(40) NULL,created_by VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX challenge_public(status,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS community_entries (id VARCHAR(64) PRIMARY KEY,challenge_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,body TEXT NOT NULL,product_id VARCHAR(64) NULL,status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL,moderation_note VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL DEFAULT '',created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,updated_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,INDEX challenge_entries(challenge_id,status,created_at),INDEX challenge_owner(user_id,created_at))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS community_votes (entry_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,user_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL,created_at VARCHAR(40) NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(entry_id,user_id),INDEX challenge_votes_user(user_id,created_at))
